images.name: KOGNUS
images.story_scene: Vignette inventee de Kognus comptant les cles avant sa ronde dans la Z13.
images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserving narrative illustration edit for Kalistar.
INPUT ROLES, in exact order: Image 1 is the sole EDIT TARGET and the authority for ALL content and composition. Image 2 MOMO is the PRIMARY PAINTING-STYLE reference. Image 3 VALAZAR and Image 4 VOLODEN are supporting painting-language/detail references only. Never import their characters, costumes, objects, buildings, poses or palettes into Image 1.
TASK: Repaint the ENTIRE target image in the recognizable handmade painterly language of Momo, while strictly preserving its content. Make a substantial visible change of painting execution, NOT a grain filter over the original, NOT merely color grading.
PAINTING: construct faces, hands, clothing and environment from deliberate opaque gouache and oil brush planes. Broad and medium broken bristle strokes, scumbled worn surfaces, chiseled painted highlights, colored shadows, layered irregular paint edges. Alternate lost and found contours as in Momo. Facial anatomy stays believable and expressive but rendered by color shapes, without photographic pores or smoothly airbrushed skin. Unify figure and background in the SAME painterly treatment; no sharp photographic character on a painted backdrop. Retain the reference level of narrative detail and legibility, not a crude abstract sketch. Avoid photo-realism, plastic 3D, anime linework, manga eyes, glossy game render, artificial depth-of-field blur and superficial canvas-grain overlays.
STRICT CONTENT INVARIANTS: same unique character identity, face proportions, age, expression, gaze, hair, species, head silhouette, clothes, colors, armor, jewelry, weapons and every prop. Identical scene, body pose, hand gestures, limb positions, framing, viewpoint, scale, composition, architecture and object locations. Change ONLY painting execution. Exactly two arms and two legs in the same humanoid anatomy and the same natural occlusions; no new limb, paw, tentacle, wing or joint. Do not add, remove or exchange characters or props.
COLOR/LIGHT: preserve Image 1's own local palette, saturation relationships, light direction, time of day, climate and overall brightness. Do NOT make every image dark or blue. Borrow brush language, not Momo's nocturnal blue palette or the other references' gloom.
OUTPUT: one full-bleed portrait PNG around 4:5, shortest side at least 1024 pixels; keep the source framing and aspect. No text, frame, card border, logo, watermark, collage or comparison panel.
TARGET: KOGNUS (25_NONE_KOGNUS). Preserve Kognus holding the key ring in his raised hand and the dagger at his waist with the other, his russet beard, heavy grey guard coat, warm lantern and cool stone corridor. He is without crystal: no magic or aura.

qa.review: Opaque brush planes visible across face, hands, coat and stone; identity, key ring, dagger grips and framing preserved; two arms, no extra limb; warm lantern and cool corridor retained.
